Dear Madam
If my [coadjutors](/person/229) can make room your paper shall go [in](/periodical/52) but there is a sad crowd of appeals

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: ‘Coadjutors’ presumably means [A.D.

Innes](/person/744) and [Christabel Coleridge](/person/329), and suggests the letter dates from about 1893.
